game.label: Your own Splatoon (Wii U) dump: the folder with code, content and meta, Europe v16 or v288 (see VersionDb in the repo). Disc images must be extracted first.

prepare.label: Recompiler, fonts and game files from your dump

exit_codes.2: The setup needs a few free tools on this PC (CMake, a C++ compiler, Python). Install them and set up again.
exit_codes.3: That folder is not a supported Splatoon dump: it needs code, content and meta from your own Wii U (Europe, v16 or v288).
exit_codes.4: The game has not been built yet. Run the setup on the game's page first.

settings.label: Resolution
settings.help: What the game renders at: 720p is the console's own, native is your desktop resolution.

settings.label: Window
settings.help: Fullscreen fills the screen; windowed keeps the game in a movable window (F11 switches in game).

settings.label: Frame rate
settings.help: Frames per second; 120 and 180 add in-between frames, 30 suits weak PCs. Greyed out while Shader quality is above Off, which holds the game at 60.

settings.label: Variable refresh
settings.help: Shows each frame the moment it's ready on G-Sync and FreeSync screens. Off waits for the screen's refresh.

settings.label: Shader quality
settings.help: Off is the clean original game. Low, Balanced and High turn on the port's newer shaders (shadows, sky, reflections); they need more GPU and hold the game at 60 FPS.

settings.label: Plaza 60 FPS
settings.help: Runs Inkopolis Plaza at 60 FPS with normal game speed. Greyed out while Shader quality is above Off, which turns it on.

settings.label: Show FPS
settings.help: The frame rate and frame time readout in the corner of the screen.

settings.label: Anti-aliasing
settings.help: FXAA softens the jagged edges of the picture. Costs very little.

actions.label: Game folder
actions.help: settings.ini, the shader cache, textures and screenshots.
